Sequence number representing the order of presidents.
AC: Achievement count or notable accomplishments during the presidency.
WR: War record or military leadership evaluations.
EAp: Economic approval rating or policy effectiveness.
OA: Overall approval rating from historical assessments.
DA: Domestic affairs score, measuring internal policy success.
Int: Intellectual influence or diplomatic strategy ratings.
EAb: Executive ability in governance and administrative efficiency.
FPA: Foreign policy achievements or international relations impact.
var: Indicators for evaluating the performance of the president.
value: The corresponding value of the indicator in var column.
